name: splits-v2
definedBefore: any backtest, holdout run or forward run for this strategy. Only the data-readiness checks (bar coverage, timestamps, OHLCV, overnight ratios) had been seen; no trade, signal or performance figure existed.
change: Same periods, walk-forward and data requirements as splits-v1. Adds excludedSessions: four NYSE sessions dropped for every symbol because Alpaca has no NYSE (Tape A) trades for most of each of them (strategy/reports/2026-10-22-data-readiness.md, finding 1). Decided by the owner on 2026-10-22 (option C). This list stays the rule for every run under splits-v2 even if Alpaca later backfills these sessions; using a backfill would need a new splits version.

warmup.use: indicator and regime warm-up only; no trades are counted

development.use: building and debugging the engine; inspecting individual trades is allowed

validation.use: checking the fixed rules, stress tests and the nearby-parameter neighbourhood; any rule change after looking at validation results creates a new version and is logged

holdout.use: one final evaluation per strategy version. Running it again requires a written reason and marks the result as contaminated.

forward.from: the day forward testing is switched on (not before 2026-10-22)
forward.use: simulated forward test with the rules frozen

excludedSessions.appliesTo: every universe symbol (all 17), so the symbols stay on one common timeline
excludedSessions.handling: All bars of these sessions are removed when bars are loaded for a run (Strategy Lab and scripts/strategy-backtest.js) and the readiness checklist does not expect them. The engine and calendar are unchanged: the engine sees no bars on these days, so the existing data-gap rules in ENGINE-SPEC.md apply. A pending entry due in an excluded session lapses (entry_skipped: no next bar). A swing position whose last session is an excluded session closes at the last close before it (session_end_fallback, flagged). Any other open swing position is carried to the next session open, where a gap through the stop or target fills at that open. The excluded day still counts towards maxHoldSessions, and the first true range after it spans two overnight gaps.

sessions.reason: Alpaca has no NYSE-listed trades 09:45-15:45 ET for all 10 NYSE symbols (only the 09:30 opening-auction print)
Alpaca has no trades 10:45-15:45 ET for VRT, XOM, PG, CAT, NEE and PLD
Alpaca has no trades 15:00-15:45 ET for VRT and XOM
Alpaca has no NYSE-listed trades 09:45-15:45 ET for all 10 NYSE symbols (none at all for JNJ and CAT)

walkForward.selection: highest in-sample expectancy in R among grid points with at least 30 in-sample trades; otherwise the baseline. Out-of-sample quarters are concatenated and reported; the baseline is always reported next to it.
walkForward.note: The grid is deliberately small (9 points). Walk-forward is a robustness check, not a search for a profitable setting.

dataRequirements: Split-adjusted 15-minute regular-session OHLCV bars for every universe-v1 symbol from 2021-07-01 to 2026-06-30. Lower-timeframe (1-minute) bars are optional and only used to resolve bars that touch both stop and target. The sessions in excludedSessions are not required and are never used.
